name: Helenium

project_scope.note: The two accepted Helenium amarum varieties are taught inside the species-level learner and are not duplicate species pages. H. quadridentatum remains a provisional installed learner with its range HOLD preserved.

priority: disc-lobe color for H. amarum variety-level training
study_strategy.warning: Start with the stem and leaf architecture before the yellow flower head. H. amarum is unwinged; H. elegans, H. autumnale, and H. quadridentatum are winged.

source_concept_status.learner_action: teach yellow-disc variety cue inside H. amarum
teach brown/purplish-disc variety cue inside H. amarum

source_concept_status.note: Installed for learner use; exclude from native PASS metrics until exact target-zone evidence is sufficient.

quick_key.if: annual; stems ridged but not winged; very narrow leaves; many small heads
H. amarum with yellow disc lobes
quick_key.then: Helenium amarum var. amarum — represented inside H. amarum

quick_key.if: H. amarum with dark brown to purplish disc lobes
quick_key.then: Helenium amarum var. badium — represented inside H. amarum

quick_key.if: annual with clearly winged stems, narrow mostly entire leaves, and globose involucre
perennial with strongly winged stems, broader often toothed leaves, and larger heads
winged annual with elongated ovoid/obconic disk, roughly 10–15 rays, and 4-lobed disc corollas
